summary: Incident Intelligence Core (P0+P1+P2) backend testing completed. 36/37 tests passed (97%). All incident intelligence features verified: engine run, anomalies, incidents, KPIs, weekly summary, graph, predictions, incident detail/timeline, state patch (including FALSE_POSITIVE). No regressions on existing audit/incident/export routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Engine run endpoint produces anomalies/incidents/auto_remediation payloads with context (volatility, load, regime) and adaptive thresholds (z_score, baseline_deviation, burst_count, repeat_count)
Anomalies endpoint returns unified anomaly model fields: id, type, source, domain, severity, state, owner, linked_events, impact, root_cause, confidence_score, suggested_actions
Incident detail endpoint returns timeline chain with kinds: raw_event, anomaly, incident, remediation, resolution
Incident state patch supports FALSE_POSITIVE, INVESTIGATING, MITIGATED, RESOLVED with owner/note update
KPI endpoint returns real metrics: days, incident_count, mttd_seconds, mttr_seconds, repeat_incident_rate
Weekly summary, graph and predictions endpoints return valid payloads with expected structure
Cross-domain coverage verified - anomalies generated from multiple domains (execution, risk, system, exchange)
No regressions on existing audit/incident/export routes (/audit-logs, /audit-logs/timeline, /audit-logs/incidents, /audit-logs/trading-lifecycle)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test fixtures and engine-generated data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Incident Intelligence Core features fully tested via TestClient. All P0+P1+P2 endpoints verified: (1) POST /engine/run - produces anomalies, incidents, auto_remediation with context and thresholds, (2) GET /anomalies - unified model with id, type, source, domain, severity, state, owner, linked_events, impact, root_cause, suggested_actions, (3) GET /incidents - incident list with required fields, (4) GET /incidents/{id} - detail with timeline chain (raw_event→anomaly→incident→remediation/resolution), (5) PATCH /incidents/{id} - state update including FALSE_POSITIVE with owner/note, (6) GET /kpis - MTTD, MTTR, incident_count, repeat_incident_rate, (7) GET /weekly-summary - kpis, top_root_causes, top_domains, top_incidents, (8) GET /graph - nodes and edges with proper structure, (9) GET /predictions - fingerprint, recurrence_count, predicted_risk, risk_trend. Auto-remediation is MOCKED (safe state/history updates only). Preview URL was unstable during testing - used local TestClient as source of truth per main agent guidance.

weekly_summary.details: Returns generated_at, kpis, top_root_causes, top_domains, top_incidents
